title: Green Poplar Wood
description: Turns Poplar wood a really nice green color!
body:
![Title/Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41a38daa2ec230564ac9656eedaf440f5093d4c3.png) **

Welcome to Green Poplar Wood, it changes the wood introduced in 26.3 for the Dappled Forest biome named "Poplar" to a much nicer, green color.** ![Blocks](https://i.postimg.cc/9FLwfg0J/gallery1.png) ![Blocks and Entities](https://i.postimg.cc/Hkjc808M/gallery2.png) ![Items](https://i.postimg.cc/tCx8qw2P/gallery3.png) **
